dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: No drinking on duty days! That applies to everyone, knights and civilians alike!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I completely agree with you on that.

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: Thank you! If you've got some time to spare, would you mind dropping a few "suggestions" into the Knights of Favonius mailbox? For instance, how alcoholics have become a nuisance in your daily life, or how they've gotten in the way at work...

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: Look, I'm very much aware that a bit of drinking can boost morale and soothe the homesickness of those on the frontlines...

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: And how it can also dull one's fear and take a little of the edge off, allowing us to face the enemy head-on.

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: I, too, drank when I was a greenhorn myself. It was hard to face those grotesque abominations without a few sips of liquid courage...

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: But now that we're back in Dornman Port, the situation is completely different! While a tipple may lift the spirits, there's also a real risk to one's health and good judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: It is my fervent hope that the matter will finally receive the attention of the Grand Master that it deserves soon...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's in charge of these things, usually?

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: Great question! As disciplinary officer of the Garrison Squad, I keep an eye on the day-to-day behavior of the knights.

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: From their conduct while in uniform to how they carry themselves among civilians on their days off... There are over 200 rules that every knight has to abide by.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's way too many!

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: The first code of conduct wasn't that detailed, to be honest. We were fairly relaxed at the beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: But exchanges with the Millelith gave us many insights into about disciplinary structures. That gave us the idea to thoroughly expand our code of conduct...

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: Strict adherence to military discipline can make the squad more effective in combat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How does it feel to be stationed in Dornman Port?

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: Hmm... This may sound a little ridiculous to you, Honorary Knight...

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: But I miss Mondstadt greatly. I miss the food at Good Hunter, and the times I spent listening to the bards with Aramis while drinking like there was no tomorrow...

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: Ahem... That's beside the point, since I've quit drinking now. I'll stick to fruit juice when I get back.

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: Although there's nothing to complain about here in Dornman Port, most people hold a very deep affection for the place where they grew up, don't they?

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: I might be able to request a transfer back to Mondstadt once I put in another two years or so of duty here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, yes, that's right. I'll see you around!

dialogues.speaker: Wernher
dialogues.text: Even if you're not much of a drinker, remember to stay sober and keep your head clear!
